test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
The sentence below has a word in which the letters are jumbled up. Rearrange the letters of that word, written in capital letters, to form the correct word.

The ETNSIL night was interrupted only by the gentle rustling of leaves in the breeze.
solution:
The given sentence is: The ETNSIL night was interrupted only by the gentle rustling of leaves in the breeze.

The word in which the letters are jumbled up is 'ETNSIL'.

The correct word for these jumbled letters will be 'SILENT'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"SILENT"**.
